## Design

### 2026-10-02 — Started on the project, and currently working on the schematic of the module. Here is a result that I would like a lot:

**1h**

Started on the project, and currently working on the schematic of the module. Here is a result that I would like a lot:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/dV5DNWN0CEIJqjXEjV5AkLty6hRHMTTp/5c5f56155facb7f7609e5ec5af831acc53ea2865492c23446a77151d72c27c51.png)

Due to the fact that I am using the ESP32 chip itself, you need to have essential parts for the ESP to work. It took me some time to start learning the parts, and that was about how much time I had.

![Screenshot 2026-10-01 at 22.14.47](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/dV5DNWN0CEIJqjXEjV5AkLty6hRHMTTp/ac23d44e8fb37efda28bb1a6870eed31c197bd0f04758ffe700b7c8d2e22393e.png)

### 2026-10-03 — Ok, so I finally finished my schematic for the board. I used the ESP32-S3 Schematic Checklist shown below:

**7h**

Ok, so I finally finished my schematic for the board. I used the ESP32-S3 Schematic Checklist shown below:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/dV5DNWN0CEIJqjXEjV5AkLty6hRHMTTp/4bcfd73c3aa8d70470b7973d5d3187957a56a5c804045357ec4f138f6e8412f2.png)

to create my schematic. It took a really really long time due to the fact that I found out halfway through the design that I was using the ESP32 checklist, not the S3.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/dV5DNWN0CEIJqjXEjV5AkLty6hRHMTTp/afa5678e87b2ca311cee0f86188655527cd3aacc286271b2d14533131c7eec32.png)

(It may look the same but its really different if you look closer.)

I sectioned everything off to make the design look cleaner, which it did (shown below).

![Schematic](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/dV5DNWN0CEIJqjXEjV5AkLty6hRHMTTp/a06786ffeb4f7133142286698daa80f71f3c42847e58cf4a80b433e4f8ad1519.png)

If you think that the purple text on my design was bugged out or something, it was because I decided to display the part number on the symbols, to make it easier to identify the part number, as you can just copy it fast.

![Screenshot 2026-10-03 at 10.48.49](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/dV5DNWN0CEIJqjXEjV5AkLty6hRHMTTp/c261ac79737bf121cdabc41b656732c7d695e84eaf680760a0a4b94ae64b982c.png)

So creating this was really beneficial due to the fact that you could see the amount of parts there were for each type, and also the part number, making it easier to send the parts and things like that.

![Screenshot 2026-10-03 at 10.54.14](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/dV5DNWN0CEIJqjXEjV5AkLty6hRHMTTp/7ffdc7c306784552b9536bd525f19873e9896171ce11e85adf7e62155e16729b.png)

I tried my best to find parts from this section:

![Screenshot 2026-10-03 at 10.58.21](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/dV5DNWN0CEIJqjXEjV5AkLty6hRHMTTp/7e26737d8c0f07b029711ede01a64f9d8f52f2ca7b28c470c6bdcbc9949492dd.png)

And as shown, there is zero loading fee, minimizing the cost of each board, meaning I can probably print more.

Another thing that took a long time was footprints, as I had to pick out the correct ones, which was pretty tedious, as I barely do hardware and had to watch a few videos on it.

![Screenshot 2026-10-03 at 11.00.53](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/dV5DNWN0CEIJqjXEjV5AkLty6hRHMTTp/cd7bfdcac80ea24ab94e0b1cdfa6810b96d3b510b9b6d2e37b714c2f9b1691cb.png)

Alr, thats it from me today! I'll work on the PCB after I publish this devlog! Bye!!
